entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:1
segments: The song of songs, which [is] Solomon's.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: Let Him kiss me with the kisses of His mouth; for Your loves [are] better than wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: For Your ointments have a lovely fragrance; Your name is [as] oil poured out; therefore the virgins love You.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Draw me, we will run after You, The King has brought me into his chambers; we will be glad and rejoice in You, we will remember Your love more than wine; the upright love You.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I [am] black, but comely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Do not look on me, that I [am] black, that the sun has looked on me. My mother's sons were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; [but] my vineyard I have not kept.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: Tell me, [You] whom my soul loves, where do You feed, where do You lie down at noon? For why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of Your companions?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: If you know not, most beautiful among women, go in the footsteps of the flock; and feed your kids beside the shepherds' tents.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: O My love, I have compared you to My mares among Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Your cheeks [are] beautiful with ornaments, your neck with chains.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: We will make you borders of gold with studs of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: While the King is in His circle, my spikenard gives its smell.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: A bundle of myrrh [is] my Beloved to me. [He] shall lie all night between my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My Beloved [is] to me [like] a cluster of henna in the vineyards of Engedi.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: Behold, you [are] beautiful, my love; behold, you [are] beautiful; you [have] doves' eyes.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: Behold, you [are] beautiful, my Beloved, yea, pleasant. Also our bed [is] green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: The beams of our house [are] cedar, [and] our rafters are of fir.
